plugins.name: moraine
plugins.description: Moraine is an AI-native procedural modeling tool for real-time 3D assets. It lets you build, refine, and extend 3D assets together with an AI agent — the agent writes the recipe, tests verify your declared requirements, you decide what they become. This plugin installs or upgrades Moraine, scaffolds a workspace, and hands off to the authoring guide it ships.
